title: While healing unseen, walk to a visible cube instead of standing still (HEAL_PICKUP_ON)

single_decision: Move the existing Build 12 cube pickup (farmGoal, cubes only) above the stand-still heal branch, only while farmOk, t >= 10 s and no drop is listed. Nothing else changes: no new target list, no memory, no hunt, no hiding change.
trigger: mode would be 'heal' (me.hp < HEAL_HP 0.9 * max, all higher branches declined) AND farmOk AND farmGoal is a cube (not a drop, not a hunt target) AND obs.t >= 10 AND obs.drops.length === 0
hook: brain.ts act(): insert one guarded branch immediately before the heal branch at brain.ts:821 (`} else if (me.hp < HEAL_HP * me.max_hp) {`), reusing the farm pickup move of brain.ts:833-835 (travel to farmGoal.pos, mode 'farm, pickup'). farmOk is brain.ts:560-562, the cube choice brain.ts:577-581, chase give-up brain.ts:597-602. farmOk already requires enemies.length === 0, so the 'heal, hiding' (seen) case can never be displaced. Flag in params.ts next to FARM_ON.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit obs.t >= 10). Never starts while any supply drop is listed in obs.drops (called and not yet taken; protocol.md:359 every mech sees it from the moment it is called), so it never runs while a drop is announced/active and can never displace drop run/hold (those need a listed drop). Off = champion exactly (flag false short-circuits).

evidence.sim_trigger_state: Champion standing in 'heal' with a visible zone-safe cube goal (t >= 10, no drop listed): 33 episodes in 22/192 games (25/192 without the drop gate); cube distance median 39 m (p10 11, p90 67); HP median 0.67 (p10 0.34); episode median 3.8 s (p90 15.1 s); alive median 14, t median 39.3 s (p10 18.1, p90 62.3).
evidence.sim_outcome: After the episode the champion picked the cube up within 20 s in only 13/33 episodes; in 16/33 an enemy came into view first (farm closes) and in 4/33 neither happened.
evidence.heal_context: coord/data/research/heal-positioning.md: champion heal time is 87.5% standing; regen works when left alone (546 undamaged heal episodes +43.0 HP mean); about 20% of heal time is unseen (18.4% covered and unseen + 1.5% open and unseen, seeds 2000+3000), and the unseen-with-a-visible-cube slice is a narrow, quiet part of it.
evidence.protocol: Regen needs 5 s without dealing or taking damage; movement is not a condition (protocol.md:291; brain.ts:795 'Walking does not stop regen'). A cube heals +4% of max HP immediately and adds +4% damage (protocol.md:425).
evidence.watcher: Idle (not engaged) pickup rate 3.94 vs 2.27 cubes/min and mid-phase 5.11 vs 3.12 (SKILLS.md, 21029/21109 s idle, 88/86 matches); high teams move more when hurt and not engaged: speed at HP < 35% eng_0 7.14 vs 5.02 m/s (evasion.md, 872/606 ticks, 59/59 matches).
evidence.showdown_first_fights: PR #145 coord/research-doug-1941.md: 'I am already under 70% HP' at first hit KILL/DIED 2/20 (n=40); more cubes 166/74 vs fewer 100/220.

estimated_activation: Re-counted on P29 champion code: 17/192 games (base 0: 9/96, 905 ticks total across both sets; base 1000: 8/96). Narrow gate would be 20/192. Official 2000+3000 / 4000+5000 not run by the builder (Sim Tester full screen is due).
closest_prior_test: P24 HEAL_COVER=2 (3.79, -0.38): walked while hurt, but toward a hide spot and only when SEEN; P37 runs only when nobody is in view or known within 160 m, and walks to an item the champion already targets at HP >= 90%. Farm family: B12/B13 KEEP; P23b late idle sweep (4.00) and P25/P25b cube memory (retired/hold) are different decisions (torso sweep; remembered cubes to 150 m). P25c is still building on cube memory; if both are built they must stay separate flags and separate screens.
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: HP at the next enemy contact and cubes at death/end not higher than the champion in fired games; or deaths < 40 s / damage taken during the walk higher (drone aggro at 45 m, protocol.md:325); or fired < 10/192.
risks: Pins: as built, the walk has its own checklist give-up (no 1 m of progress for 3 s -> cube on healSkip for the match), not the farm's 15 s FARM_CHASE_S; builder hazard 0+1000 found no new 20 s+ pin and 0 flag ticks in any pin window. Drops: gated on obs.drops empty, never runs while a drop is listed. Noise: hurt-and-recently-damaged moves stay silent-capped by the champion (brain.ts:873); steps carry 40 m (protocol.md:397). Drones: cubes from a destroyed drone lie near other drones' homes; a walk inside 45 m of a drone draws fire and resets regen.

implementation: brain.ts: one guarded branch `} else if (healCube) {` immediately before the stand-still heal branch (`} else if (me.hp < HEAL_HP * me.max_hp) {`, now brain.ts:847 on the P29 code), after drop hold and drop run. healCube = farmGoal.pos only when HEAL_PICKUP_ON, obs.t >= HEAL_PICKUP_T (10), farmOk, farmGoal is a cube object from obs.cubes (not a drop, not a hunt target), !farmHold, HP < 90%, no drop listed, no drop run/hold, and the cube is not in healSkip. Own no-progress give-up: if the distance to the cube has not dropped by 1 m for HEAL_PICKUP_STUCK_S (3 s) the cube goes on healSkip for the match (heal pickup only; the Build 12 farm choice is unchanged). Move = travel() to the cube (same walk as farm pickup), mode "heal, pickup". params.ts: HEAL_PICKUP_ON (default false), HEAL_PICKUP_T = 10, HEAL_PICKUP_STUCK_S = 3.
